asChild.description: Use the provided child element as the default rendered element, combining their props and behavior.

render.description:
Render the part as a custom element, combining their props and behavior.

Call `props()` to spread the part's props, passing your own to merge them rather than overwrite them.
The state arrives as an accessor:
`render={(props, state) => <button {...props({ onClick: mine })}>{state().open}</button>}`

defaultValue.description:
The initial value of the slider.
Use when you don't need to control the value of the slider.

ids.description:
The ids of the elements in the machine.
Useful for composition.

name.description: The name of the slider. Useful for form submission.

onValueChange.description: The callback function for when the value changes.

onValueChangeEnd.description: The callback function for when the value changes ends.
